```python
import os
from datetime import datetime

# Define the path to the notes file
notes_path = "/path/to/your-notes.md"

# Get the current timestamp
current_timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

# Read the existing content of the notes file
with open(notes_path, 'r') as file:
    notes_content = file.read()

# Append the current timestamp and work-zone content to the notes
new_content = f"\n## Timestamp: {current_timestamp}\nWork-zone contents:\n{os.environ['WORKZONE']}\n"
updated_content = notes_content + new_content

# Write the updated content back to the notes file
with open(notes_path, 'w') as file:
    file.write(updated_content)
```
